name: %name%
purpose: Bundled language pack that ships the app's English UI strings (locale "en").
llmContext: Declarative-only BUNDLED language pack: it carries the app's actual English UI dictionary as contributes.translations[0].entries (full coverage of src/i18n/ko.json's key set) and is the single source of truth for English. It is NOT executed by the central plugin host — each window's bootstrap imports this folder's manifest.json directly (src/i18n/packs.ts, lazy import.meta.glob) and registers it through registerBundledLocale before the first paint, so English never depends on an async host snapshot. The folder shape is identical to a third-party language pack on purpose (dogfooding): copy it, change the folder name to language-pack-<code>, change contributes.translations[0].locale/label, and translate the values. main.js is intentionally whitespace-only — there is nothing to run. Requires permission "i18n" + kind: "capability".

entries.note.guide.intro: Welcome to Note Rang. Work through the list below and you'll feel at home in five minutes — tick each box as you go.
entries.note.guide.outro: Done reading? Feel free to delete this note — you can always open it again from Settings › Help.
entries.note.guide.title: Getting started
entries.note.guide.tune-data: Your notes are plain `.md` files in the storage folder. Move that folder in Settings › Storage folder, and export or restore in Settings › Backup.
entries.note.guide.tune-settings: Open Settings to change the theme, colors, font, shortcuts and plugins. Saving applies to open windows right away.
entries.note.guide.window-archive: “{archive}” doesn't delete anything — it puts the note away, and you can reopen it from the notes list any time.
entries.note.guide.window-drag: Drag an empty spot (anywhere without text) to move this window. Drag an edge to resize it.
entries.note.guide.window-toolbar: Hover near the top of the note to reveal its toolbar, then try “{fold}”, “{transparency}”, “{pin}” and “{allDesktops}”.
entries.note.guide.write-format: Select text by dragging or with Shift+arrow keys and a formatting bar appears — try “{bold}” and “{color}”.
entries.note.guide.write-insert: Right-click in the body for “{insertImage}” and “{insertYoutube}”. You can also paste an image straight from the clipboard.
entries.note.guide.write-markdown: Markdown works as you type — try `# Heading`, `**bold**` or `- [ ] a to-do`.
entries.note.guide.write-wikilink: To link notes together, write [[Note title]]. Click it and that note opens.
